train_spm_model: train a SentencePiece model from a text corpus using the train_spm function with config and output path
run_TrainSpmModule: run the TrainSpmModule to train a SentencePiece tokenizer and return a Vocab object with model and vocab files
create_TrainSpmConfig: create a TrainSpmConfig dataclass with output_dir, train_data_file, vocab_size, and model_type parameters
validate_Vocab_output: validate that a Vocab output has existing model_file, vocab_file, and dict_file paths after training
convert_vocab_to_fairseq_dict: convert a SentencePiece vocab file into a fairseq dictionary format using the Vocab dict_file property
